name: azure
description: Azure and Entra ID from Claude: Microsoft's Azure MCP Server one-to-one, 105 dedicated tools, the full Azure CLI, eight interactive views, and up to five tenants. Uses az login unless you add service principals; read-only until you open the write gate.
long_description:
Read and operate Microsoft Azure and Entra ID through your own account or through service principals in several tenants.

Microsoft's own Azure MCP Server (@azure/mcp 4.0.0-beta.9) ships inside this extension and every one of its tools is available under its own name: the same 74 service tools you get from `azmcp server start`, or all 575 individual commands if you switch the Microsoft tool layout to all. They run as the tenant you pick and pass through the same write gate as everything else.

On top of that come 105 dedicated tools for compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, Key Vault, monitoring, cost, security and Entra ID, the Azure CLI one-to-one (Azure CLI Read, Azure CLI Run, Azure CLI Help), and ARM and Microsoft Graph escape hatches.

Authentication: by default your existing az login, so there is nothing to paste. Add up to five service principals (tenant id, client id, client secret) to work across tenants without the CLI; every tool takes an optional profile argument to choose one, and every view has a tenant menu. Secrets are stored in the OS keychain and never shown.

Eight interactive views render inside Claude: tenants, an estate overview, virtual machines and web apps with Start/Stop/Restart, costs, a resource explorer, security posture, and an Azure Services explorer where you can search every Microsoft command, see which dedicated tool does the same job, fill in a generated form, run it and read list results as a table.

Writes are real but gated. The connector starts read-only. Set Mode to write for creates and updates, and Allow destructive operations for deletes, stops, restarts and anything Microsoft marks destructive. Credential reads such as Key Vault secrets, App Service app settings and App Configuration values count as writes. Every operation is bounded by the RBAC and Graph permissions of the identity in use.

azure_mode.title: Mode
azure_mode.description: read or write. In read mode write tools stay listed and refuse, naming this setting. Set write to let Claude create and change resources.

azure_allow_destructive.title: Allow destructive operations
azure_allow_destructive.description: true or false. The second gate for deletes, stops, deallocations, restarts, key regeneration and other disruptive operations, including the same commands through the Azure CLI tools. Has no effect unless Mode is write.

azure_default_profile.title: Default tenant profile (optional)
azure_default_profile.description: Profile name tools use when no profile is given. Empty: the first service principal below, or your az login when none is set. Use "cli" to default to your az login.

azure_profile_name.title: Tenant 1: profile name
azure_profile_name.description: Short name for this tenant, e.g. contoso. Pass it as `profile` on any tool. Leave the four Tenant 1 fields empty to use only your az login.

azure_tenant_id.title: Tenant 1: tenant ID
azure_tenant_id.description: Entra tenant id for this service principal.

azure_client_id.title: Tenant 1: client ID
azure_client_id.description: App registration (client) id. Grant it the roles it needs, e.g. Owner or Contributor on the subscriptions.

azure_client_secret.title: Tenant 1: client secret
azure_client_secret.description: Client secret. Stored in the OS keychain.

azure_subscription_id.title: Tenant 1: default subscription ID (optional)
azure_subscription_id.description: Default subscription for this profile, and for your az login when no service principal is set.
